Origin: PR #9 review thread https://github.com/aaif/wg-security-and-privacy/pull/9#discussion_r4015259811. Fernando marked this as "needs to be added".

**Current text.** [L257](https://github.com/aaif/wg-security-and-privacy/blob/e757d350133fea0858dda1deec13dbca923b3cf8/deliverables/DRAFT-agentic-ai-security-best-practices-guide.md?plain=1#L257) says "MITRE ATLAS v4.6.0–v5.4.0 | Technique codes referenced inline" and [L255](https://github.com/aaif/wg-security-and-privacy/blob/e757d350133fea0858dda1deec13dbca923b3cf8/deliverables/DRAFT-agentic-ai-security-best-practices-guide.md?plain=1#L255) says "ASI classification ... throughout". No AML.T or ASI code appears anywhere in the document.

**Proposal.** Add a bracketed tag at the end of each clause where the guide already describes the behavior, e.g. `[ATLAS AML.T0110, AML.T0051.001; ASI01, ASI04]`, and update the ATLAS row to v5.6.0 (the agent-specific techniques were added in 5.x). Mapping below, validated against the ATLAS 5.6.0 data file and the OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications 2026. Line numbers are for the merged deliverable at e757d35.

| 48 | Tool poisoning via description field | AML.T0110 AI Agent Tool Poisoning; AML.T0051.001 LLM Prompt Injection: Indirect | ASI02, ASI04 |

I can open the PR for this if that is easier than discussing it here.
